name: Rachel Bauer

five_sec.trust_why: 90,000 families and a 4.8, but the main button is a CEO letter
five_sec.next_step: Look for allergy settings and Kroger
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Menu screen with 'Replace' and 'Modify'; it's a planner

full_page.what_stopped_me: 'Ollie writes a recipe just for you' - with a tree-nut allergy I want tested recipes, not improvised ones. No Kroger/King Soopers. $25/month on the pricing page vs 'prices in the app' on the meals page
full_page.whats_missing: Allergy filter shown, Kroger, one price

OL.quote: 'A recipe just for you,' written by AI. With a tree-nut allergy I want a tested recipe. Also $25 a month vs my $6.99.

five_sec.who_for: People who curate their own recipes
five_sec.trust_why: 4.8 App Store / 4.7 Google Play right at the top
five_sec.next_step: Check what happens to recipes from blogs

full_page.what_stopped_me: Bring-your-own recipes; Mealime gave me recipes. The clipper pulls from websites, which is the Samsung Food problem I'm trying to escape. No per-person allergy settings mentioned
full_page.whats_missing: Built-in recipes, per-person allergy filter, named Kroger delivery

PTE.quote: Since 2008 and 4.8 stars, so it won't vanish like Mealime. But 'save recipes while you scroll' is Samsung Food's blog-hopping in a nicer coat.

five_sec.who_for: Families who want plans picked for them

full_page.what_stopped_me: Plans are by diet for the whole house (Plant Based, Gluten Free), not one vegetarian teen plus a nut-allergic 10-year-old. No nut filter shown. Price not on the page

EM.quote: Kroger and 15 plans, fine. But it's one 'Plant Based' plan for the whole house, not one vegetarian teen and one nut-allergic 10-year-old.

five_sec.what_is_it: Weekly planner with family voting by text and a one-tap Instacart/Walmart cart
five_sec.trust_why: Founder named lower down, 'no card' clear; no App Store rating, and nothing on how long it's been around

full_page.what_stopped_me: 'Over 500 families' is small; Mealime had far more and still closed. King Soopers isn't named, only 'Kroger cart on Family'. I can't see a recipe's steps, only titles. Unclear whether the free plan's nut-allergy handling is per person or for the whole household
full_page.whats_missing: King Soopers named, launch date, a recipe screen, export of favorites

DD.quote: Per-person profiles with allergies and a Kroger cart for $39 a year beats Samsung Food+. Now tell me King Soopers counts, and that you'll still be here next year.

five_sec.who_for: People who don't want to shop

full_page.what_stopped_me: Pecans, walnuts and candied peanuts across this week's menu; no allergy controls shown; price behind a zip code

HF.quote: Pecans, walnuts, candied peanuts all over this week's menu, and I can't see a price without a zip code. Pass.

dd_offer.why: Stated on the home page and pricing page: 14 days, no card, then add a card or go back to Free
dd_offer.expect_day_15: Per-person profiles and the Kroger cart switch off and I'm on Free; no charge because I never gave a card.

head_to_head.reason: Per-person allergy profiles and a Kroger cart at $39 a year, under what I pay Samsung Food+

EM.reason: Per-person profiles beat one diet plan for the whole house

PTE.reason: Plan to Eat will outlast anyone, but it makes me bring the recipes

OL.reason: Tested dinners and $39/yr vs AI-written recipes at $25/mo

HF.reason: I control the ingredients; HelloFresh's menu is full of nuts

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Pricing page (/start): name the Kroger family stores that work (King Soopers etc.), say when DinnerDrop launched, and say you can export favorites if you leave.
